Name: (AT) Soren's Big Gay Ikea Trip
Author: nordkyst
Description:
Have you ever thought, "Man, I love my pixel wife, but I wish our house was gayer?" Me too, so I made this mod.

Ok seriously though, I wanted to practice pixel art and learn the Alternative Textures framework, and I thought others might enjoy some of the furniture I made. It's themed around various sweet & silly lesbian stuff that my friends and I think are cute. I'll probably add more to it in the future. I hope you enjoy!

[*][size=2][House Plant] -- lavender in pink pot, butchfemme teddy bears[/size]
[*][size=2][Large Futan Bear] -- blahaj, blahaj with trans flag, 2 djunkelskogs[/size]
